settings.title: Use neutral bases for unknown bags.
settings.text: If you do not know the golfer's bag color, black, white, navy, and green accessories are the safest premium path.

settings.title: Off-course gifts should still feel useful.
settings.text: Desk gifts work best when they reference golf without turning into novelty clutter.

settings.title: Make group gifting look intentional.
settings.text: For teams, clients, and events, repeat one accent across the whole order.

settings.title: Know the bag
settings.text: If you know the bag color, match it. If you do not, stay neutral.

settings.title: Choose the use case
settings.text: Round-ready gifts should lean towel/tools. Desk gifts should stay polished and simple.

settings.title: Keep it coordinated
settings.text: One accent color makes even a small gift feel more premium.

settings.title: Golf Desk Gifts
settings.text: Polished golf-minded gifts for workspaces and off-course moments.

settings.title: Build Your Bag
settings.text: Use the configurator if you know their bag color and style.

settings.heading: Golf gifts that do not feel random.
settings.subheading: A simple path for choosing Built Birdie gifts by bag color, use case, and how much you know about the golfer.
